jina: Time and term of office of President
maudhui: (1) The President-elect shall assume office as soon as possible after he is declared to have been elected President, but in any event he shall assume office before the expiration of seven days. (2) Unless he sooner resigns or dies, a person elected President shall hold office for a period of five years from the date on which he was elected President. (3) A person elected President shall hold office until - (a) the day on which his successor takes the oath of office; (b) the day on which he dies; (c) the day on which he resigns; or (d) he otherwise ceases to hold the office of President. (4) Where the United Republic is at war and the President considers that it is not practicable to hold an election, Parliament may by resolution extend the period of office of the President, but no such extension shall exceed six months at any one time. (5) Every President-elect shall, before assuming office, take and subscribe before the Chief Justice of the United Republic the oath of allegiance and such other oath relating to the execution of the office of President as may be prescribed.
vifungu: (1) The President-elect shall assume office as soon as possible after he is declared to have been elected President, but in any event he shall assume office before the expiration of seven days.
(2) Unless he sooner resigns or dies, a person elected President shall hold office for a period of five years from the date on which he was elected President.

(3) A person elected President shall hold office until - (a) the day on which his successor takes the oath of office; (b) the day on which he dies; (c) the day on which he resigns; or (d) he otherwise ceases to hold the office of President.

(4) Where the United Republic is at war and the President considers that it is not practicable to hold an election, Parliament may by resolution extend the period of office of the President, but no such extension shall exceed six months at any one time.

(5) Every President-elect shall, before assuming office, take and subscribe before the Chief Justice of the United Republic the oath of allegiance and such other oath relating to the execution of the office of President as may be prescribed.
